title: Roadmap
description: Near-term substrate milestones for connectome-fs — core, adapters, demos, and partner-facing surfaces.
html:
Roadmap

Where the substrate is going. Dates are intent, not contracts.

Now (foundation)

  • ✓ GUID nodes, multi-names, associations, sharded search (v0 CLI)

  • ✓ Editions / VCS-collapse design docs

  • ✓ Semantic change units essay

  • ✓ Org site + Antora docs (Valentus)

Next

  • ❏ Stable C ABI + first language wrapper (D)

  • ❏ Userspace projection: hierarchical views without stealing names

  • ❏ Edition context API sketch (process-scoped bindings)

  • ❏ File-manager demo: connectome-aware listing / dual citizenship

Later

  • ❏ WinFsp / FUSE mount path (or explicit non-goals if delayed)

  • ❏ Syntax-aware auto-forward prototype for identifier-level patches

  • ❏ Plugin kits for existing file managers (not forks-first)

  • ❏ Internet-enabled features (sync / publish associations) behind a real backend

Partner surfaces (not owned here)

  • Dev-Centr — agent workspace + git practice guides

  • HCI-Nerdz — editions UX and cognitive offload essays

  • OpenShellOrg — shell query / graph navigation standards
